name: All in One Lock Price
description:
The Lock Price module in Odoo enables managers to set fixed prices for products, preventing any changes to the price in sales orders, purchase orders, invoicing, and accounts. This ensures that product prices remain consistent across different stages of the sales and purchase cycle, providing greater control over pricing and preventing unauthorized adjustments.

        Key Features:
        1) Lock Price for Users:
           - Managers can enable the "Lock Sale, Purchase, Product, and Account Price" Boolean option to lock the product prices for specific users, ensuring no modification.

        2) Read-Only Price in Product View:
           - When the price is locked, users can only view the locked price in the product view, making it impossible to edit.

        3) Price Lock in Sale Orders, Purchase Orders, and Invoicing:
           - Locked prices will appear as read-only in sales orders, purchase orders, credit notes, bills, and refunds, maintaining price integrity across transactions.

        Use Cases:
        - Ensure that product prices are consistent and prevent any unauthorized price changes.
        - Control pricing during transactions across multiple Odoo modules.

        Supported Views:
        - Navigation to lock product prices:
          * Product View: Sales → Products
          * Sales Order View: Sales → Quotations
          * Purchase Order View: Purchases → Requests for Quotation
          * Invoicing View: Invoicing → Bills and Credit Notes
